Name: Grandpa's Weapon
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[i]I like to make mods for little things I find in the game and this was one of those where I was watching through the intro and had an idea of: Oh! Let me do that! [/i]

In the afformentioned Intro there's a sword that hangs above the fireplace while you're talking to grandpa, and I wondered - where did that sword go? 

Now there's no need to wonder! Once you've proved yourself you'll get the sword in the mail the next day. 

How to get the sword: 

[Spoiler] > Reach level 40 in the mines, the next day, Marlon will send you a letter with it in the mail. Level was upped to account for the better sword :] [/Spoiler]

Sword Stats (Subject to change if I think it needs to be a bit better):

[Spoiler] 10-16 Damage
+1 Speed
+1 Defense
+15 Crit Chance [/Spoiler]


[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
